# Execution

## Goal

Complete the authorized unfinished work in the current task.

## Procedure

1. Read the task, plan, execution record, relevant guidelines, and current working tree.
2. Reconcile stale assumptions with actual files. Preserve concurrent changes.
3. Implement the next dependency-ready step using the established stack and current phase.
4. Update contracts and meaningful tests when behavior changes. Keep provider credentials and authorization server-side.
5. Record actual edits, commands, results, failures, and unresolved work in [Copilot_Execution.md](../TaskLogs/Copilot_Execution.md).
6. Continue until the authorized scope is complete or a concrete external dependency prevents progress.

## Output

Reviewable changes and honest execution evidence. Add `# !!!FINISHED!!!` only when the requested work is complete. Run the verifying stage when requested or required by the change. Do not commit, publish, or deploy solely because execution was invoked.
